description:
Create a compression spring in FreeCAD with the following specifications:

- **Helix radius:** 9 mm (measured to the center of the wire)
- **Helix pitch:** 5 mm
- **Number of turns:** 8 (total helix height = 40 mm)
- **Wire cross-section:** circular with radius 1 mm

The spring should be created by sweeping a circular profile along a helix path. One recommended approach:
1. Create a **Helix primitive** (Part menu > Primitives > Helix) with the parameters above.
2. Create a **circular sketch** (radius 1 mm) on a plane at the start of the helix, centered on the helix wire path.
3. Use **Part Sweep** (or Additive Pipe) to sweep the circular profile along the helix edge.

Save the completed model to: `~/Documents/FreeCAD/compression_spring.FCStd`

The final saved file must contain a valid solid shape representing the helical spring.
